literal: grace desiring in-the-path he-who-stood wealth desiring evil-things to-plot will-perish
translation: Even one who stands in the path of virtue desiring grace will perish if he covets another's wealth and plots evil.
modern: அருளை விரும்பி அறவழியில் நின்றவனும், பிறர் பொருளை விரும்பி அவருக்குத் தீங்கு செய்ய நினைத்தால் அழிந்து போவான்.
explanation: The couplet warns that even a person who has committed to a virtuous life seeking grace can be destroyed by greed. 'அருள்' (grace) and 'ஆறு' (the path of virtue) represent the highest moral standing. However, if such a person yields to 'பொருள் வெஃகி' (coveting wealth) and begins to plot 'பொல்லாத' (evil things) to acquire it, their previous virtue will not save them, and they will perish ('கெடும்').
